ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which part of this food web will be directly affected if the cactus stops growing?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food web, with plant labels such as Mojave Yucca, Cactus, Shrub at the bottom; Cactus is located in the middle at the bottom. Observe the direct arrow starting from Cactus; the arrow points to the Chuckwalla on the right side. Reasoning: The question asks if cactus stops growing, which part of the food web will be directly affected. For direct effects, one should look at organisms directly connected to cactus and directly dependent on cactus, rather than indirect predators further up. Since the direct arrow from Cactus points to Chuckwalla, the one directly affected is Chuckwalla.
